description: PROBE ONLY, never in a release build. Applied on top of edits.json only by tools/cmf_pin_panel.py --probe-controller. Makes the map treat input as an Xbox pad for button pictures, so the hint row shows controller buttons (and their CMF button pictures) while the tester uses the mouse: every InputFeedbackButton is set up as a gamepad button, draws its Xbox picture clip, and the picture family in use reads xbox. The game's own versions stay in the class under the names getCurrentPadIconGame and cmfPadFamilyGame, unused.
